description: Strenghtening American Infrastructure (SAI) Homeowner Survey - Hurricane Laura is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This EAGER proposes a new convergent methodological framework that scalably integrates existing NSF-investments to study household recovery processes and decisions in the wake of Hurricane Laura. Coverage: Lake Charles, LA. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Hurricane Laura, Recovery, Homeowner, Survey, Lake Charles, Louisiana. Published 2023-07-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
